question: Should configured Discord role mentions wake every eligible agent associated with that role, and what safeguards should govern that fan-out alongside direct, reply, and mass mentions?
rationale: This is not a repair of an established behavior: it adds a public configuration surface and chooses message-routing semantics that can affect multiple agents in the same guild.

options.title: Adopt explicit role triggers
options.body: Add a separate opt-in role-ID trigger field and define bounded fan-out plus precedence rules in the Discord plugin.

options.title: Defer to broader access-policy design
options.body: Keep this request open until the broader Discord policy work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/69748 establishes compatible routing semantics.

options.title: Decline multi-agent fan-out
options.body: Keep direct user mentions as the only wake signal and document role mentions as non-triggering.

recommendation.title: Adopt explicit role triggers
recommendation.body: Add a separate opt-in role-ID trigger field and define bounded fan-out plus precedence rules in the Discord plugin.
